intents.name: open_terminal
intents.doc: Opens a terminal on a sandbox, in the focused pane by default. The agent mode starts a stopped sandbox.

intents.name: start_sandbox
intents.doc: Starts a stopped sandbox by opening its agent terminal, as the web UI's Connect does.

intents.name: select
intents.doc: Marks a sandbox as selected (no `sandbox`: none).

intents.name: set_layout
intents.doc: Sets how many terminal panes show (1 to 4) and whether two split side by side or stacked.

intents.name: start_jarvis
intents.doc: Creates Jarvis's sandbox (the first time) or starts it, and opens its session (`POST /api/jarvis/start`).

intents.name: send_to_jarvis
intents.doc: Sends what the person typed in this screen's input `input` to Jarvis, masked first. The core reads the text itself; the input is emptied once sent and kept when sending fails. A typed yes or no answers a waiting proposal (a yes only a low-risk one).

intents.name: toggle_jarvis_panel
intents.doc: Opens or closes the Jarvis panel docked on the right (no `open`: toggles).

intents.name: talk_start
intents.doc: Starts recording for Jarvis (push-to-talk from a button).

intents.name: talk_stop
intents.doc: Stops recording; the words are transcribed and sent to Jarvis.

intents.name: read_aloud
intents.doc: Reads one message of the conversation aloud (`data.jarvis.log[i].id`).

intents.name: approve_proposal
intents.doc: Opens the core's dialog for that proposal. Never approves by itself: only the person's click on the dialog does.

intents.name: refuse_proposal
intents.doc: Refuses a Jarvis proposal, with an optional reason Jarvis is told.

intents.name: open_link

args.url: an http:// or https:// URL, required

intents.doc: Opens an `http://` or `https://` link in the browser.
